item.title: head
item.description:
• Apply a monochrome site theme and testing policy

    Replace the purple accent and tinted surfaces with shared neutral light and dark palettes, flat controls, subtle borders, and consistent typography. Add a homepage panel with GitHub, GitLab, Blog, Docs, and Projects links plus a permanently visible indented project list derived from the existing pages. Show destinations beside titles and leave space below the fixed header. Use thin muted scrollbars and rounded taxonomy labels, preserve dark-mode release controls, and wrap long documentation links on narrow screens. Unify documentation headings, navigation, search, code, tables, and callouts, and show each project landing title. Use CSS highlighting classes so code follows both color modes. Distinguish sidebar group headings from their items and use plain action rows with subtle hover states. Give sidebar groups distinct uppercase labels and keep taxonomy items compact with wrapping and inline counts. Give tree links horizontal padding so text is inset within active and hover backgrounds. Add a fingerprinted Al SVG favicon using outlines from the pinned Architects Daughter font, with no browser font dependency.
